newsitem.title: FRANCE: High winds destroy houses in Algeria, snow falls.
newsitem.headline: High winds destroy houses in Algeria, snow falls.

text.p: Winds reaching more than 100 km per hour (60 mph) destroyed seven homes in Algeria's Khenchela province and injured three people, one seriously, on Sunday, the official Algerian news agency APS said on Monday.
Families made homeless have been housed temporarily in tents and a school in the province, some 400 km (250 miles) southeast of the capital, Algiers.
APS said the winds were accompanied by "icy cold and rain". It added that the first snow of the year had also fallen on the Aures Mountains.
